description: versus-2p-bamboo with D_800A3790 (0x800A3790) poked 0x23 -> 0x2B at the top menu (a modified game): the only stores are 0x23, by func_80046B44 (boot and every reinit) and func_80046E8C (no caller), so bit 3 is never set in retail; gpu_PrepareViewAndFlushDrawQueue (32D04.c:1146-1150) then calls gpu_GetLastFogOtIndex and puts the last fog-move OT index in scratchpad 0x1F800010 instead of 0x7FFFFFFF
